rooms.title: Potatoverse / Canon
rooms.purpose: Own project-canon identities, definitions, roles, symbolic systems, and mature Potatoverse synthesis without claiming independent empirical status.
rooms.epistemic_policy: Project-canon claims remain explicitly project-canon and do not become external historical or scientific facts by placement here.
rooms.time_policy: Preserve dated development and distinguish later synthesis from earlier source material.
rooms.provenance_policy: Preserve source lineage when the Room stores or derives source-bearing claims; public projection never replaces provenance.
rooms.freshness_policy: Review material when its source changes, its public synthesis becomes stale, or a validator/audit reports ownership or route drift.

rooms.epistemic_policy: Source class and provenance remain distinct from later interpretation, synthesis, and corroboration.

rooms.epistemic_policy: Historical sequence preserves when something happened, when it was said, and when it was later interpreted as separate facts.
rooms.time_policy: Temporal sequence and date precision are first-class; later recognition is never silently moved to an earlier event date.
